title: 高盛Kendra Lau：中美利差罕见倒挂，银行板块为何成避风港？
speaker: Kendra Lau

segments.en: You've owned way in the banks. You neutralize the insurers. Tell us a little more about the thinking behind that. Well, I think the big picture here is that we are seeing a pretty significant and quite unprecedented situation where US rates in China ways
segments.zh: 你大幅超配银行，对保险则中性。谈谈背后的思路。我认为大背景是，我们正看到相当显著且前所未有的情况：美国利率与中国利率走势分化。

segments.en: are diverging. So you talk about 10-year bond news in the US now above around 5 percent.
segments.zh: 所以提到美国10年期国债收益率现在约在5%以上。

segments.en: But at the same time, Chinese bond news, 10-year bond news, and now at 1.6.
segments.zh: 但同时，中国10年期国债收益率现在在1.6%。

segments.en: And the UGAPs is above 3.5 percentage point. We've never seen that before in history.
segments.zh: 而两者利差超过3.5个百分点，历史上从未见过。

segments.en: So against the backdrop, we think that essentially that reflects a few things.
segments.zh: 在此背景下，我们认为这主要反映了几个因素。

segments.en: Number one is the growth and inflation expectations, differentials between the two major economies in the world.
segments.zh: 第一，全球两大经济体在增长和通胀预期上的差异。

segments.en: And when you translate that into equity market strategy, we think that banks should do well.
segments.zh: 将其转化为权益市场策略，我们认为银行表现应会不错。

segments.en: Particularly Hong Kong listed Chinese banks. The reasons are number one. When rates are high in the US, people look for value.
segments.zh: 尤其是香港上市的中资银行。原因一：美国利率高企时，人们寻求价值。

segments.en: Look for dividend plays in Hong Kong. And obviously banks should benefit.
segments.zh: 在香港寻找股息机会，银行显然应受益。

segments.en: And at the same time, when you look at onshore rates, 1.6 percent, that implies that equity risk premium remains very elevated in the onshore market.
segments.zh: 同时，内地利率1.6%意味着内地市场股权风险溢价仍处高位。

segments.en: And we think that we'll likely provide some support for short-duration equities and banks with fit into that category.
segments.zh: 我们认为这可能会为短久期权益资产和银行板块提供一定支撑，而银行也属于这一类别。
